finalText:
**The build passes now.**

One real error, hiding under all the noise:

```
ERROR EBUILD01 link-failed: src/core/settings.js — ReferenceError: retries is not defined
```

`resolveConfig` set `maxRetries: retries`, but there is no `retries` variable — it lives on the `env` argument. I now read `env.retries` and fall back to a new `DEFAULT_RETRIES` of 2.

Exit code 0, 3 warnings, 0 errors.

Those 3 warnings are still there and none of them break the build:

| Code | Where |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` deprecated-api | `src/legacy/adapter.js` |
| `W2213` unused-export | `src/utils/format.js` |
| `W3307` circular-import | `src/core/graph.js` ↔ `src/state/tracker.js` |

Those files do not exist in this tree, so the warnings are baked into `build.js` itself.
